verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms documents background automation mechanics well suited to autonomous operation — managed payout schedules that run without manual intervention (docs-12), webhooks to avoid polling for async status changes (docs-13), and automated fraud/risk monitoring rules (docs-4, docs-18) — plus an MCP server that lets AI agents connect via natural language (docs-14, probe-4). However, there's no evidence tying these into an AI-agent-orchestrated 'set it up once and it runs autonomously' workflow specifically for AI-native users. Missing for 10: documentation of AI agents configuring/scheduling these automations via the MCP server end-to-end, evidence of persistent agent-driven task execution, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of autonomous agent use.
